note: Language-neutral slot families. Family names never embed a language (rev 2: no `gadget.php`); language lives in the slot value and in vocab/equivalents/. Families beginning sink. or gadget. or fs. mark the record's transferable core; equivalence tables exist for sink.* and fs.* families.

families.source.http.request: Input enters via a request parameter/query.
families.source.http.body: Input enters via the request body (incl. JSON keys).
families.source.http.cookie: Input enters via a cookie/header-carried blob.
families.source.http.header: Input enters via an HTTP header.
families.source.file.name: Input is a file's name/metadata (the non-obvious command-injection source).
families.source.protocol: Input is binary protocol/file data (native parsing surface).
families.source.env: Input arrives via environment/config reachable to the attacker.
families.sink.sql.concat: SQL string built by concatenation — see vocab/equivalents/sink.sql.concat.json.
families.sink.exec.shell: Subprocess with shell semantics — see vocab/equivalents/sink.exec.shell.json.
families.sink.exec.noshell: Subprocess without shell (argument injection) — see vocab/equivalents/sink.exec.noshell.json.
families.sink.template.render: Template engine render of user input — see vocab/equivalents/sink.template.render.json.
families.sink.http.request: Server-side outbound fetch keyed on input (SSRF) — see vocab/equivalents/sink.http.request.json.
families.sink.url.reconstruct: Absolute URL/authority rebuilt from an unvalidated Host header — every consumer of the reconstruction (path guards, redirects, reset links, SSRF fetches) now reads attacker-chosen values.
families.sink.merge.recursive: Recursive merge/assign of user keys into objects.
families.sink.memory.copy: Native copy/alloc bounded by untrusted length.
families.fs.path.join: Path-joining primitive — reset semantics per language — see vocab/equivalents/fs.path.join.json.
families.gadget.prototype: Prototype-pollution gadget (inherited property later read on a code path).
families.delegate.tool: External tool delegate/placeholder expansion (ImageMagick delegates, processors).
families.guard.waf: WAF/inline filter in front of the sink.
families.guard.escaping: Quoting/escaping in front of a command sink.
families.guard.ssrf: SSRF guard: allowlist, private-IP check, scheme filter, per-hop revalidation.
families.guard.resolve-check: Path guard: resolve-then-prefix check (the correct one to defeat).
families.guard.format: Format/magic-byte validation in front of a decoder.
families.guard.locking: Concurrency guard: locks, transactions, atomic ops (resists races).
families.guard.session-state: Per-session authorization state (authenticated flag, validated binding) that dispatch must consult before acting — the guard defeated when a handler is reachable without the state being read.
families.encoding.string: Quote/comment-breaking payload shape for string contexts.
families.encoding.url: URL confusion forms (userinfo, backslash, brackets, alt-IP encodings).
families.encoding.object-stream: Serialization format signatures (O:8:, rO0AB, \x04\x08, pickle b64).
families.oracle.channel: Extraction channel for blind cases: reflected|boolean|time|oob.
families.oracle.error: Error-message feedback loop as the oracle.
families.header.forwarding: Whether auth/credential headers follow the request cross-origin.
families.size.length: Untrusted length/count field sizing a native operation.
families.token.claims: Forged JWT claims (sub/role/admin/exp) accepted after a signature bypass.
families.guard.signature: JWT signature-verification policy (accepted algorithms, key selection) — the guard a confusion attack defeats.
families.encoding.jwt: base64url JWT segments; alg:none variants, HS256-with-public-key confusion, kid/jku/x5u header abuse.
families.sink.auth.jwt-verify: The jwt verify/decode call site — see vocab/equivalents/sink.auth.jwt-verify.json.
families.proxy.desync: Front-end/back-end disagreement on where a request ends (CL vs TE).
families.encoding.http-framing: Framing obfuscation: dual CL+TE, TE header variants, H2 downgrade.
families.guard.pipeline: Proxy normalization/patch state — what resists smuggling.
families.oracle.timing: Response-time stall as the smuggling detection oracle.
families.source.http.graphql: GraphQL query body (incl. aliases, batching, fragments).
families.guard.introspection: Introspection disablement (and whether error suggestions remain).
